entries.phase_stage: Phase 0 continuous integration (landing D, 2026-09-21: what the suite costs)
entries.name: What the suite itself costs: its wall clock and its collected count
entries.rule: one ordinary single-process `pytest -q` from the repository root finishes under 4,500 s AND collects at least the cases it collects today. The seconds are a MACHINE-decided number (kpi_rules.MACHINE_KINDS): recorded everywhere, judged only on the quiet reference machine (Apple M4, 10 cores). The collected count is nobody's machine and is judged everywhere, because seconds bought by running fewer cases is the one saving a speed landing may not make
entries.measured_on: the whole suite, one process, no shards, from the repository root -- the same single-process run the CI split divides across jobs and does not make cheaper. `cases_reported` counts the cases pytest reported passed, failed or errored, so it is the collected count less the skips, and `exit` is recorded beside them as context: what the suite COSTS is this entry's subject, and whether it is green is every other entry's and the suite's own
entries.evidence: RE-STAMPED ON THE QUIET MACHINE on 1578bee, the tree that closed stage 3: 3,963.9 s over 7,654 collected and 7,602 reported, EXIT 0, at a one-minute load average of 2.5 as it began and 1.9 as it ended. The close of stage 3's review read 3,982.8 s over 7,647 and exit 1. Against 3,085.8 over 7,109 the suite grew by 545 cases with stage 3 and the seconds with it; it stands 536 s inside its 4,500-second bound, and the five-shard wall clock is about 20 minutes. THE FIVE SHARDS OF THE SAME COMMIT report 7,601 passed and 50 skipped against this run's 7,602 and 49: ONE case skips under the split CI runs and runs here, by design: the claim inventory's check of the state page's stated count, which stands down on any selected run and which CI's shard-coverage job carries through tools/ci/shards.py --prove. MEASURED on this worktree, one process, with each run's load average recorded because the reference machine was shared with other work. BEFORE, on 89a598d: 7,087 collected in 3,809.4 s at a one-minute load average of 2.8 to 6.6, the twenty slowest 2,087.5 s of it (55 per cent) and the top three 1,323.7 s (35 per cent), two of those three fixture SETUP rather than a slow case. AFTER, on the landing 1d62d4a: 7,107 collected in 3,589.2 s under the same sharing, a second run of the same code reading 3,480.4 s. AFTER THE REPAIR PASS, on 59a8fec and on a near-quiet machine (one-minute load average 3.03 as the run began, 2.43 as it ended): 7,109 collected in 3,085.8 s (51 min 25 s), 7,059 passed, 49 skipped, 1 failed. That is the number this entry now carries, and it is the first of the three taken on a machine close to quiet: the state page records 3,282 s for the predecessor tree on a quiet machine, so the same measurement made the same way reads 196 s (6 per cent) less on this tree with 22 more cases. THE ONE FAILING CASE is the state page's own record of the collected count -- the page says 7,087 and the tree collects 7,109 -- which moves in the commit that updates that page; tools/ci/shards.py --prove reports the same two numbers. The run began at a load average of 3.03, a hair above reference_machine.quiet_load_average_below, so the seconds are RECORDED here and judged nowhere (kpi_rules.seconds_judged_here). The bound of 4,500 s is an hour and a quarter on the reference machine: a ceiling that stops the suite drifting back towards the 1 h 20 m to 3 h the two-core CI cells were reading, not a target.

entries.evidence: ITS DRIVER RUNS AGAIN AND THE INTEGRITY CAUSE IS CLOSED (2026-09-24, commit 5cd28db). It could not run at the close of stage 3's review: `tools/measurements/kpi_scale.py numeric --kpi` exited 1 with `RecursionError` inside `taxonomy._lattice_fill`, so no value was printed for this entry. The walk that decides whether a tail's published pair would give its own cells back (plan P4-D349, commit ee56999) recursed ONCE PER ROW OF THE TAIL, and a tail's rows are about a hundredth of the column. BISECTED TO THE ROW on one Gaussian numeric column at two decimal places, seed 20260913, at the default floor of eleven: 98,456 rows describe cleanly and 98,457 rows raise, so `synthtwin profile` refused no such table and CRASHED on it from there upward. A probe says why the boundary sits exactly there: at 98,456 rows the back-solve is not entered at all, and at 98,457 it is entered seven times on a 985-row tail. Across commits: a3c0cd1 describes 100,002 rows with a 1,001-row tail, 89e2947 and a7bbc21 both raise. THE SAME WALK NOW CARRIES AN EXPLICIT STACK and answers what it answered, at the same cost: over 4,002 seeded shapes at four budgets -- 32,016 fill comparisons, 16,008 verdict comparisons and 4,002 published tail sides -- the pre-repair text and the repaired one return the same multiset, take the same steps, spend the budget in the same place and mark the same remainders dead, and the step budget is charged once per call as before (`tests/test_tail_back_solve_without_recursion.py`, five mutations watched red, a no-op edit green). THE WALK IS NOT WHAT COSTS THE SECONDS HERE. Describing ONE Gaussian numeric column at the default floor: 100,000 rows 15.9 s, 200,000 rows 31.4 s, 1,000,000 rows 163.1 s -- linear. entries.name: Seeded truths: each recovered inside its yardstick with the real table's significance decision, or named as not carried
entries.rule: Each truth of the six tables' truth files (tests/analyst_tables.py: curves, thresholds, interactions, a three-way parity, a rare outcome, dependent missing cells, zero mass, overdispersion, hazards, the ICC, dropout, a fading hazard, censoring by centre, a competing event, a formula read as the share of rows breaking it, the null table's quiet) is recovered where its estimate is supported, lies inside its yardstick and keeps the real table's significance decision and sign -- on a majority of twin seeds -- or is named in the twin's report as not carried with a reason the floor arithmetic confirms (no such line exists today, K-BC-11). A truth is charged only where the replicate of the same run gets it back; the replicate's misses are counted beside (replicate_missed), never as the twin's. K-S7-01's three-way clause is folded in: three_way_missed_unnamed counts the truths of three columns or more. Bound: the controls hold (the replicate gets back at least half the floor-eligible truths, the shuffled twin at least 25 points fewer) and the truths measured do not fall. Target: McNemar's z of the truths only the replicate gets back against those only the twin gets back at most 2, for all truths at both sizes and for those of three columns at 20,000 rows (a perfect twin cannot promise none missed: a stand-in at 20,000 rows missed 6 the replicate got and got 3 it missed, z 1.0). At 5,000 rows no three-way truth is supported -- the diabetes x current smoker cell holds about 10 events, and ventilation x age over 75's 31 fall to 10 in one half -- so the fast part's three-way clause is reported, not judged. A twin recovering no truth reads the square root of the replicate's recoveries (replicate_recovered, three_way_replicate_recovered), so a clause binds only where the replicate gets back more than 4.

entries.name: Prediction: a model trained on a twin of half the table and tested on the other half (TSTR)
entries.rule: Boosted trees (60 rounds, depth 3; 40 at 5,000 rows) trained on today's twin of half A, made by the product from half A alone, tested on half B: the AUC gap to the model trained on half A itself over the AUC's yardstick (the root mean square of AUC(A to B) minus AUC(B to A) over the four splits), and the rank correlation of the twin-trained model's gains with half A's against the replicate's, on the seeded outcomes a tree can learn and, at 20,000 rows, every other two-valued column whose half-A model reaches an AUC of 0.6 on half B (S2 3.2: one model per binary outcome; trained_models counts them) (death on ST1 and ST6; ST4's parity has flat pair margins, so a greedy tree finds no first split on the real table either). A model missing on any seed of a side it is expected on (today's twin at every twin seed, the controls at theirs) counts for that side as an infinite gap and a rank correlation of -1, whatever its other seeds read (twin_models_missing counts the seeds), and the yardstick is the one measured, unfloored (a yardstick of 0 makes any shortfall infinite). Bound: the controls hold (the replicate within 3 yardsticks, the shuffled twin beyond, neither missing a model) and today's twin no more than 15 yardsticks (fast) and 20 (20,000 rows) past the shuffled twin. Target: within 3 yardsticks and a rank correlation at most 0.3 under the replicate's (checkpoint 4).
entries.measured_on: Tiers, yardstick and controls: plan P4-D398. The model trained on a twin of half A never sees half B, so its score is not flattered by the test rows (Esteban et al. 2017).

entries.name: The broad discriminator: real rows told from twin rows, the pMSE ratio over the replicate's
entries.rule: A logistic discriminator of real rows against twin rows on every usable column's main effect (numbers and dates standardized, numbers with two spline terms, labels by level, missing indicators) and the products of the first eight key columns (six at 5,000 rows), every number held to the real table's range; its propensity mean-squared error over its value under no difference, (k - 1)(1 - c)^2 c / N (Woo et al. 2009; Snoke et al. 2018), today's twin's over the replicate's, the worst table; the ten columns it rests on most named in the detail. On the null table ST5 a shuffle is a perfect twin with exact marginals, its ratio under 1, and ST2's rows come several to a subject, which that null value does not allow for (the replicate's own ratio ran 2.6 to 15.2 at 20,000 rows), so the maximum, the controls and the comparison with the shuffle leave both out, their ratios over the replicate standing beside (null_pmse_over_replicate, clustered_pmse_over_replicate). A discriminator that could not be fitted is never left out: on today's twin it is an infinite ratio (discriminators_failed), and on either control it voids the run. Bound: the controls hold (the shuffled twin over three times the replicate on every table read) and today's twin at most 1.5 times the shuffled twin there. Target: at most 3 times the replicate on every table (checkpoint 4; the finished product's, 1.5).
